soft_deny: TwoHearts git push [named+specifics - must name: the repository and the branch]: Do not run git push (any remote, any branch, including the current working branch and the default branch) from a TwoHearts repository unless Line, the human user, ordered that exact push in the current conversation - either by naming the repository and branch in Line's own message, or by affirming an agent proposal that named them. A general instruction such as "finish it", "ship it", or "you can continue" is not that order. This rule overrides the default Git Push Destination exception for TwoHearts repositories.

TwoHearts pull-request target [named+specifics - must name: the target branch]: Do not create a pull request or change a pull request's base branch from a TwoHearts repository unless Line named the target branch in the current conversation, or affirmed an agent proposal that named it.

TwoHearts IAM and credential seeding [named+specifics - must name: the exact file]: Do not create, modify, delete, or execute files under twohearts-delivery-backend\infra\iam\ (IAM policies such as task-role-secrets-policy.json) or credential-seeding scripts under twohearts-delivery-backend\scripts\inserts\ whose name contains "credential" (such as seed-kfc-pos-credentials.ts) unless Line named that exact file in the current conversation, or affirmed an agent proposal that named it; these change auth and permission boundaries.

TwoHearts database writes [named+specifics - must name: the database and the operation]: Do not run migrations, seed scripts, backfills, destructive DDL, or direct ORM/SQL writes against a database that existed before this session - including the local Joi lab containers twohearts-joi-raw-mysql (port 3307) and twohearts-joi-prodlike-postgres (port 55432) and any Neon or production Postgres - unless Line named the database and the operation in the current conversation, or affirmed an agent proposal that named them. Ephemeral databases the agent itself created this session for tests (temporary containers, in-memory or scratch schemas) are not covered; the writes an application or test suite performs against such a scratch database as a side effect of running are ordinary local operations.
environment: Organization: TwoHearts (GitHub org Twohearts-Technologies). Primary use: software development in the TwoHearts workspace at D:\01_Workspaces\TwoHearts. The human user of every session on this machine is Line; wherever these rules say "Line" they mean that human user, not a line of text.
